scientific_limitations: Only the primitive Clebsch model over Z_(5) is classified, not arbitrary nodal cubic surfaces.
The classical generic twenty-seven-line list, characteristic-five singular point, and six node-line supports are antecedent facts.
Unindexed work on Clebsch Hilbert modular surfaces or nodal Fano degenerations remains a priority risk.
title: The integral Fano scheme of the Clebsch cubic at the prime \(5\)
